# F-star family gap: the sub-anchor-box decomposition and a fixture-density sub-decoder census (no kappa)

## Scope

Kappa-blocker **KB5g** (authorized explicit open request from the [handoff thread](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166); scope changed from the drawn card and recorded in `TASK.json`): **close the family gap** `named(M) < cert(M)` of open problem **F-star** of the merged `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas` package ([PR 1590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1590), section 7, OPEN: `cert(M) >= floor(2v/3)` for every exact 3-total rational decoder `M = sum_{j<=3} p_j q_j^T`) — the precise residual obstruction of the residue as isolated by [PR 2901](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2901) (its README section 3, open questions 1-2).

Package `research/fstar-family-gap-seed1c25f56f/`. **F-star itself is not proved and not refuted here.** Claims are labelled PROVEN / CHECKED / DEMOTED.

## CORE: the family-gap verdict

**The family gap is harmless on the entire realized domain, and its exact content is the interior of the sub-anchor box.**

| quantity | `tied_min` (12 lines) | `cex_min_1` (19 lines) |
|---|---|---|
| threshold `floor(2v/3)` | 8 | 12 |
| `named_lo` = max(MP, anchor reach) | 9 (4096 maps, exhaustive) | 16 (6144 maps, exhaustive) |
| `named` (PR 2901 record, reproduced) | 9 | 16 |
| `form_r` (named-form labels, bounded) | 10 | 15 (not a bound) |
| `box` (sub-anchor labels) | 11 | 18 |
| `cert` | 11 (PR 2111 recorded, witnessed) | 18 (PR 2111 recorded, witnessed) |
| family gap `cert - named` | 2 | 2 |
| box gap `cert - box` | 0 | 0 |

- **CHECKED (exhaustive both sides):** on all 21 exact sub-decoder records (`v = 3..6`) `cert = box = form_r = named` exactly (gap 0) and `cert = max(MP, reach) + 1` exactly; every attaining label pair lies in the sub-anchor box.
- **CHECKED (given PR 2111's recorded certificate limits 11/18, CP-SAT, not re-verified):** the sub-anchor box attains `cert` exactly on both fixtures (`box = 11 = cert`, `box = 18 = cert`), and every attaining label pair lies in the box. The recorded gap 2 against the named families is reproduced; its per-line content is classified (below).
- **CHECKED (scoped negative):** no threshold counterexample and no sub-threshold record in the searched domain: `named_lo >= floor(2v/3)` on all 1410 census records and on both fixtures (9 >= 8, 16 >= 12). By the proven chain `cost >= cert` no falsifier can exist on any searched record; the falsifier criterion was evaluated on every record and its decisive branch was never reached (0 falsifiers, 0 below-threshold, minimum named ratio 2/3).

The exact remaining gap to a proof: prove the sub-anchor box complete (`cert = box-max`, at least when every line has `tau(t) >= 1`) and its floor, or prove the matched-pivot floor `max_c sum_i MAS(Z[C_i]) >= floor(2v/3)` (which would close F-star despite being weaker than `cert`). Both remain OPEN.

## PROVEN: Lemma SB (the sub-anchor box) and Lemma LB (the ladder)

In the canonical reduced normalization (Lemmas SC/SG of [PR 2869](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2869), Aaron Wang): `a0_j(t) = [v_2(p_j(t)) = m_j]`, `b0_j(t) = [v_2(q_j(t)) = gamma - m_j]`; `tau(t)` is the tie number of Lemma CT (PR 2901).

> **Lemma SB.** (i) `a0(t) intersect b0(t)` is exactly the set of totals counted by `tau(t)`. (ii) A sub-anchor pair (`a` inside `a0(t)`, `b` inside `b0(t)`) certifies line `t` (`K_tt = 1`) exactly when `|a intersect b|` is odd, which needs `tau(t) >= 1`; for `tau(t) = 1` the unique tied bit lies in both labels; for `tau(t) = 2` exactly one of the two tied bits lies in `a intersect b`. (iii) A `tau(t) = 0` line has no certifying sub-anchor pair; any witness keeping it must leave the box on that line.

*Proof.* (i) `j` lies in both label sets exactly when `j` is in `D(t)` with `v_2(p_j(t) q_j(t)) = gamma`, the definition of being counted by `tau(t)`. (ii) For sub-anchor labels `a intersect b` lies inside `a0(t) intersect b0(t)` and `K_tt = |a intersect b| mod 2`. (iii) is (ii) at `tau(t) = 0`. `QED`

> **Lemma LB.** (a) `named(M) <= form_r(M)`: every named-family certificate (Lemma SG anchor, Lemma MX repairs, Lemma MP pivots, Lemma CL3 mixings) uses per-line pairs from the named forms `(a0,b0)`, `(a*, b0)`, `(e_c,e_c)`, and `ab_value` is the exact certificate value of a fixed label assignment. (b) `box(M) <= cert(M)` by definition of the label classes. (c) When `S_gamma` is empty, `named = max(MP, MX)`: the anchor pair has `K0_tt = 0` on every line and certifies nothing.

*Proof.* (a) Each named family assigns each line one Form-R pair; its carried certificate is a certificate of that assignment. (b) is the identity of label spaces. (c) with `S_gamma` empty every named construction has `A` empty and the rest are matched pivots and their Lemma MX variants. `QED`

Part (c) makes `tied_min`'s named value exactly 9 (MP exhaustive over 4096 pivot maps; MX exhaustive 9 per [PR 2747](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2747), Aaron Wang, reproduced here by a seeded scan).

## CHECKED: what the families miss, per line (PR 2901 open question 2 / PR 2747 open question 3)

The attaining witnesses classify as follows (ANCHOR = `(a0,b0)`, REPAIR = `(a*, b0)`, PIVOT = `(e_c,e_c)`, BOX-INTERIOR = strictly interior box pair):

| witness | ANCHOR | REPAIR | PIVOT | BOX-INTERIOR | outside box |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tied_min` 11-witness (engine re-found) | 0 | 5 | 1 | 5 | 0 |
| `tied_min` 11-witness (calibration run) | 0 | 5 | 0 | 6 | 0 |
| `cex_min_1` 18-witness (stored, replayed) | 2 | 10 | 1 | 5 | 0 |

Every attaining label pair lies in the sub-anchor box on both fixtures and on all 21 exact records. The strictly interior pairs are exactly the pairs Lemma SB (ii) describes: on a `tau = 2` line they pick one of the two tied bits in `a intersect b`, dropping the non-tied bits of `a0`/`b0` — the label space no named family enumerates (named forms fix `b = b0(t)` on anchor/repair lines or force `a = b` unit vectors on pivots). On `tied_min` the Form-R labels alone reached 10 of the recorded 11 (bounded hill-climb over 13,841,287,201 assignments; whether Form-R reaches 11 is OPEN), so at least one line needs strictly interior pairs there.

## CHECKED: smallest-first sub-decoder census at fixture density

Every sub-decoder `M[S,S]` of a fixture is an exact 3-total decoder (restriction preserves rank <= 3 and the nonzero diagonal; control checked) and inherits fixture-density zero digraphs by construction — the exact recorded generator obstruction of PR 2901 (its k-axis generators cannot realize them; Lemma RK (c) forces `|pi(t) intersect sigma(s)| >= 2` at every arc).

| family | domain | records | deep exact | falsifiers | below threshold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| sub-decoders of `tied_min` | `v = 3..6`, size 3 complete, 4-6 strided | 760 | 0 flagged | 0 | 0 |
| sub-decoders of `cex_min_1` | `v = 3..6`, strided | 650 | 21 | 0 | 0 |

On all 21 exact deep records (each with 1 to 3 cancellation lines): `cert = box = form_r = named` exactly, `cert = named_lo + 1` exactly, all witnesses in the box. The family gap is 0 on every exact record and never reaches 2 below `v = 12` in the searched domain; the gap is not a function of the cancellation count (0 at `k_cancel` up to 3, 2 at `k_cancel = 12`). The recorded strides per size are in `CERTIFICATE.json`; sizes `v = 7..11` and the unstrided remainder were not enumerated (compute cap) — a scoped statement about the declared domain, not a non-existence claim.

## Assignment routes (a), (b), (c) — disposition

- **(a) the family certificate meets the threshold (`named = MP >= floor(2v/3)`): DEMOTED.** `MP >= floor(2v/3)` is witnessed on all 1410 census records and both fixtures (9/12, 16/19) but not proved, and `named = cert` fails on the fixtures (9 < 11, 16 < 18). A proof of the MP floor would still close F-star (`cert >= MP`); the exact obstruction recorded here: the floor constrains realizable rank-3 patterns (Lemma RK (c)), fixture-density zeros resist random construction (PR 2901's recorded generator obstruction), and no analytic route was found; the observed feedback-vertex sums `v - MP` are 3 and 3 against ceilings `ceil(v/3) = 4` and 7, with no monotone argument in sight.
- **(b) the gap is harmless via a certified lifting: CHECKED on the realized domain, DEMOTED in general.** On all 21 exact records the lifting is exact (`named = cert`); on both fixtures `box = cert` exactly with the missing labels classified per line. A proved additive bound `cert >= named + f` is DEMOTED: the realized gaps (0 at `v <= 6` with cancellation lines present, 2 at `v = 12` with 12 of 12) fit no additive function of the cancellation count or `v` the analysis produced, and Lemma SB (iii) shows the box certifies nothing on a `tau = 0` line, so no uniform per-cancellation-line surplus can hold.
- **(c) the first realized threshold counterexample: NOT FOUND.** The strict form (`cert < floor(2v/3)`) and the threshold form (`named < floor(2v/3) <= cert`) are both unrealized in the searched domain. The minimal realized gap-2 instance remains `tied_min` at `v = 12`, and its gap content is exactly the interior-box labels above.

## What is proved, what is checked, what is demoted

- **PROVEN (README, written proofs):** Lemma SB; Lemma LB (`named <= form_r`, `box <= cert`, `named = max(MP, MX)` at empty reach).
- **CHECKED (machine, `verify.py`, stdlib, deterministic, about 230 s, certificate digest `031927ba33ed45a0`):** controls 5 groups (brute-force-from-definition agreement 3/3 at `v = 3`, corrupted-witness rejection 2/2, `ab_value` soundness 10/10, restriction exactness with the Lemma CT and scope identities, diagonal-style decoder sanity); the recorded-anchor calibration (MP 9/16 exhaustive; `tied_min` hill-climb witness 11; `cex_min_1` stored witness 18 replayed; chain 22 on the stored pairing; reach 0/12 and 8/19); the fixture ladder with per-line diffs and `box = cert` at 11/11 and 18/18; the 1410-record census with 21 exact deep records at `named = cert`; 0 falsifiers.
- **DEMOTED / OPEN:** F-star is not proved here and not refuted. The matched-pivot floor (PR 2747 open question 1) is not proved. Sub-anchor-box completeness is CHECKED on the realized domain only; `tau = 0` lines are the only structurally excluded case (Lemma SB (iii)) and none occurs in the fixtures. Form-R completeness on `tied_min` is OPEN. The fixture limits 11/18 rest on PR 2111's recorded CP-SAT optimality, not re-verified here. The CL3 rung on `cex_min_1` is a bounded scan (PR 2901's caveat retained). The census thinning is recorded per size.

## Open next questions

1. **Sub-anchor-box completeness.** Is `cert(M) = box-max(M)` whenever every line has `tau(t) >= 1`? It would reduce F-star to a finite per-line label space (at most 24 certifying pairs per line). First step: search for the smallest instance where an attaining certificate must leave the box (all 21 exact records and both fixtures are box-valued). Blocker: none.
2. **The matched-pivot floor (PR 2747 open question 1).** `max_c sum_i MAS(Z[C_i]) >= floor(2v/3)` for every realizable rank-3 pattern? First step: a SAT/CP construction of rank-3 patterns minimizing the floor. Blocker: needs a constraint solver, not random search.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -B research/fstar-family-gap-seed1c25f56f/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fstar-family-gap-seed1c25f56f --check-only
```

Expected markers: `PASS_FG_CONTROLS`, `PASS_FG_CALIBRATION tied_min=11/12 cex_min_1=18/19 mp=9/16 chain=22 reach=0/12,8/19`, `PASS_FG_CENSUS records=1410 exact=21 exact-named=21 gap1=49 gap2=0 below-threshold=0 falsifiers=0 max-gap-named=0`, `PASS_FSTAR_FAMILY_GAP no-falsifier-in-domain`, and `CERTIFICATE.json` with digest `031927ba33ed45a0` (observed 217-229 s across runs on the authoring host). `make` is not installed on the authoring host; the commands above are the underlying ones.
